shortDescription.ru: Жёсткая плакатная система: жирная антиква-гротеск, толстая обводка, offset-тень и один оранжевый сигнал.
shortDescription.en: Hard poster system: heavy grotesk display, thick rules, offset shadow, and one orange signal.

philosophy.ru: Сила важнее полировки. Крупный тип, толстая линия и честный контраст создают характер, который агент может воспроизвести правилами, а не «вабибом».
philosophy.en: Force over polish. Big type, thick line, and honest contrast create character an agent can reproduce with rules—not vibes.

bestUseCases: Launch landing pages and campaign sites
Portfolio / studio marketing with strong voice
Agent handoff when the brief asks for raw poster energy
avoidFor: Long-form documentation that needs quiet reading
author: design-atlas

sources.title: Brutalist Websites (brutalistwebsites.com)
sources.note: Contemporary web brutalism as a cultural reference for raw structure — not a style dump.

sources.title: Constructivist / poster display traditions (general design history)
sources.note: Oversized type and hard geometry as poster communication tactics.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 contrast guidance
sources.note: Orange accent must remain a signal, not low-contrast decoration.
